verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents versioning and review for agents. Registering an agent records its instructions, model and tools so changes can be tracked across versions, and new versions are compared against previous ones on the same frozen task suites, with recorded actions to inspect. Rollback is the weak point: it appears only as a one-line marketing claim of "autonomous fix and rollback" for production agents, with no documented mechanism. Twin reset and frozen environments restore test state, not the automation itself. Missing for 10: documented rollback to a prior agent/automation version, independent or hands-on corroboration of the versioning and review workflow.
